note: MEASUREMENT ONLY. No parameter changed. score_max, radius_mult and max_nn remain the production configuration.

neighbourhood_vs_max_nn.reading: where this exceeds the cap the covariance is built from an arbitrary subset chosen by KD-tree traversal order

order_dependence.how: same points, same radius, reordered by spatial tiling with a halo of exactly the search radius; tiling cannot change a local operator's support, only the enumeration order
order_dependence.reading: non-zero flips mean the roof membership depends on point enumeration order, not only on geometry

why_it_blocks_the_ultra_pass: both effects are driven by neighbour count inside the radius, which is a function of point density -- the one variable a medium-vs-ultra pass exists to isolate. A facet diff across the two clouds would mix this defect's density response with the roof's, inseparably.
